title: The Golden Game: Baseball in Sacramento
original_title: The Golden Game: Baseball in Sacramento
overview: Based on the book The Golden Game by Kevin Nelson, this program examines Sacramento's long baseball history. We'll look at Sacramento's first clubs and teams, including the Gilt Edge, Senators, Solons, and today's River Cats. Learn about the greatest players who came through Sacramento, including Stan Hack, Joe Marty, Tony Freitas, and Kenso Nushida.
